Hi all 

Thanks for the intro, Samantha. Quick run of what we'll need from Redwood to onboard as a vendor: 
1) Completed vendor questionnaire (fine to use the attached spreadsheet).
2) W-9 (or applicable tax form) and vendor bank details for ACH.
3) SOC 2 Type II report (can be shared under NDA).
4) Data processing addendum (DPA) and standard SLAs around availability and incident notification.

Timeline & process: once we receive items (1)-(3), our vendor operations typically completes setup within 7-10 business days. Contract/legal review runs in parallel  if there are non-standard terms it can extend that window.

Two clarifying questions for Redwood: 
- Do you invoice monthly based on usage, and can you produce an itemized invoice that maps to our cost centers?
- Who will be the signatory for contractual commitments (standard Redwood legal contact)?

I'll also attach our standard NovaBank vendor form (for your AP).

Paul
